dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing from the mid-lateral span toward the posterior peduncle, with a more abrupt taper toward the anterior head region.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Mainly smooth lateral margins with a subtle asymmetrical concave deviation on the left mid-lateral edge.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high median pixel intensity across the exposed dorsal surface, transitioning to a lower intensity at the submerged posterior.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Sharp gradient slope at the interface between the white dorsal margins and the dark surrounding medium.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct longitudinal linear feature of lower pixel intensity extending along the central dorsal midline.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Visible longitudinal recessed ridge along the central dorsal axis creating a subtle internal shadow-casting effect.
